# Everest Education & Visa Services
> Trusted education & visa consultancy in Australia since 2011.

## About
Everest Education & Visa Services (EEVS) is a family-owned education
and migration consultancy operating in Australia and Nepal. We help
students study abroad and migrants achieve PR in Australia.

## Services
- Student Visa (Subclass 500)
- Skilled Migration (189, 190, 491)
- Partner Visa
- Graduate Visa (485)
- Tax Return Services
- PTE/IELTS Training
